status: Research input, not reviewed by an ustadz. AI-assisted, not an authoritative fatwa. Every expected value carries a status and source refs; 'computed' values must be confirmed by the reviewer before they become oracles.

conventions.shares: Exact fractions as 'a/b' strings ('1' for the whole). Keys are heir ids (engine.md §5.1) and hold the GROUP share (all wives together, all daughters together). Shares of every expected block sum to exactly 1, counting 'baitul_mal', 'wasiat' and 'wasiat_wajibah:*' lines.
conventions.perHead: Per-person share where a group has more than one person; for KHI substitutes 'pengganti_<k>.L' / '.P' is the share of each male / female child of slot k.
conventions.pengganti: 'pengganti_<k>' is the slot of predeceasedChildren[k] (or of predeceasedSiblings by id in the Tarjih vector) under KHI 185.

specialKeys.harta_bersama:<spouse>: spouse's half of a harta-bersama pool, as owner (rupiah only)
specialKeys.sisa_dirujuk: residue the tool does not assign (spouse is the only heir, or the rest would go to dzawil arham): shown as 'sisa: konsultasikan' (engine.md §9.4, plan D7). Counts toward the sum of 1.

conventions.rupiah: Integer rupiah after engine.md §14 (largest remainder). 'key#i' is the i-th person of a group, in input order.
conventions.base_finalBase: Only given where the source prints the integer table: base = asal masalah, finalBase = after 'aul / radd / tashih (ikhtisar applied).
conventions.input_override: When present inside an expected block, it replaces input fields for that ruleset only (e.g. a grandchild modelled as classical cucu_lk vs. as a KHI substitute).
conventions.rulesetKeys: Keys of 'expected' are ruleset ids (klasik-syafii = 'Hasil fikih', standar-indonesia = 'Perkiraan PA', klasik-syafii-asal = MAIS-style comparison) or '<ruleset>|<switch>=<value>' for a one-switch variant. 'substitution=luas' is documented but not implemented by the engine.
conventions.alternatives: Other scholarly or legal readings, with their numbers. Not tested unless the engine implements that switch value.

status.sourced: the source prints these numbers (or rupiah that convert exactly)
status.rule: the source states the rule; the numbers follow directly with no judgment call
status.computed: derived by applying engine.md; no opened source prints them — reviewer must confirm

conventions.rujuk: An expected block {rujuk: [...]} means the engine must refuse and return those reason ids (engine.md §13).
conventions.case: Case-study vectors only (topic 'case-study', ids 'kasus-NN-*', merged from case-vectors.json on 2026-10-09): Vector-level metadata for the case page: number (plan §4), name, lessons, the case statement as written in ux.md §3 (cases 1-12) or plan §4 (cases 14-16), the plan's printed numbers in Rp juta, and 'reading' = how an ambiguity was resolved. Not compared by the engine test. Their 'sources' name dalil.json record ids ('dalil'), the dalil.json rule record ('rule'), legal instruments ('legal', article or decision numbers only) and engine.md §15 trace ids ('engineRules') instead of url/page/quote; no Arabic is retyped in them.
conventions.derivation: Case-study vectors only. Vector-level hand derivation keyed by the same keys as 'expected': eligibility, hajb, furudh, 'asabah, asal masalah, 'aul/radd, tashih (the classical integer table), per-heir fraction, rupiah (largest remainder, engine.md §14) and the self-checks. A court-column derivation that equals the fikih column gives 'sameStepsAs' plus 'switchCheck', which names each standar-indonesia switch and why it does or does not fire for this family. Not compared by the engine test.
conventions.shareBasis: A block whose shares carry no 'wasiat' or 'wasiat_wajibah:*' key gives fractions of the estate that reaches the fara'id stage (after harta bersama, funeral costs, debts and any wasiat; e.g. 'urutan-tajhiz-utang-wasiat', 'kasus-03-gonogini-utang-wasiat'). A block that carries such a key gives every line as a fraction of the estate after debts, so heirs + bequest lines sum to 1 (e.g. 'khi-ww-anak-angkat-plafon', 'khi-ww-istri-nonmuslim-16K2010', 'kasus-10-anak-angkat', 'kasus-11-anak-beda-agama').
conventions.blocked_ineligible: 'blocked' lists hajb exclusions (a dzawil-arham relative shut out by an 'asabah is listed, as in 'kh-kasus1-cucu-asabah'). 'ineligible' lists a relative entered in input but barred by a mani' (as in 'mani-pembunuh'). Omitted when empty. A court-adopted child (input adoptedChildren) is not listed, as in 'khi-ww-anak-angkat-plafon'.

case.statement: Pak Ahmad dies, leaving his wife Bu Siti, 1 son and 1 daughter; net estate 480. Nothing is divided. Stage 2 ('Hitung untuk beliau', a fresh questionnaire): her 60, plus her own property (here 0), goes to son 40, daughter 20. Totals: son 320, daughter 160.

planNumbers.klasik-syafii: Stage 1: Bu Siti 1/8 = 60, son 280, daughter 140. Stage 2: son 40, daughter 20. Totals: son 320, daughter 160.

case.reading: This vector is stage 2 only, as the plan asks ('stage 2 is new'). Stage 1 is a separate solve (wife + 1 son + 1 daughter) whose arithmetic is in derivation.stage1. Her own property is 0 as the case states; if Pak Ahmad's estate had included harta bersama, Bu Siti's own half (KHI 96(1)) would belong to her own estate at stage 2, but the case states none. No funeral cost or debt is stated at stage 2 and the plan's numbers imply none. No grandparent of Bu Siti is mentioned; the plan's numbers imply none (a grandmother would take 1/6). The same Rp 480 juta value is used for the undivided estate; a change in value over the five years is not modelled.

input.assumptions: Second stage of a munasakhat. Pewaris: Bu Siti, who was alive at Pak Ahmad's death and died before his estate was divided. Her estate = her stage-1 share Rp 60 juta + her own property Rp 0. Husband and both parents died before her. No other relative alive.
